terminology.cloud_coordination_plane: Persistent TellMeN0TE + N0TE external coordination role. It is not N0TE and it is not the N0TE build harness.
terminology.n0te_build_harness: Temporary construction machinery that selects, builds, diagnoses, red-teams, verifies and closes bounded N0TE implementation work.
terminology.runtime_truth: Registry lifecycle describes semantic/governance posture. Scheduler enabled state, execution claim and health are separate observed runtime facts and must never be inferred from lifecycle=ACTIVE.

runtime_state_contract.rule: When runtime liveness matters, query the actual executor surface and reconcile the observation. A stale ACTIVE registry row may not be represented as a running process.

observability.observation_contract: Every material action or reconciliation retains the exact observed repository/provider/runtime state and suppresses repeat work against unchanged evidence.

observability.observation_contract: At most one attempt per unchanged head/receipt/blocker; every reactivation/action/delegation is attributable to explicit current evidence.

orphan_policy: Any autonomous actor without a registered parent, reporting path, purpose, current reason, bounded failure policy, allowed mutations, wake/retirement conditions and observation contract is a governance failure.
terminal_policy: No actor may create successor work merely to remain active. N0TE build-harness construction terminates at STABLE when no currently justified work exists; the cloud coordination plane may remain persistent and quiet because it serves ongoing portfolio operations rather than perpetual construction.
